title: Holding Several Mobile Wallet Transfers at Once
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold any number of Mobile Wallet transfers at once. Each booking stands on its own, with its own confirmation number, principal, fees, exchange rate and wallet destination. The number of transfers a customer holds is bounded only by the aggregate sending limits of the customer's Personal Sender Account, the per-recipient frequency cap and the wallet provider cap that govern Mobile Wallet bookings; there is no maximum number of Mobile Wallet transfers per customer as such.

**Transfers are never combined.** A retry, a redirect or a refund on one Mobile Wallet transfer never touches another transfer of the same customer.

| Question | Answer under this clause |
|---|---|
| Is there a fixed maximum number of Mobile Wallet transfers a customer may hold? | No; only the sending limits, the per-recipient frequency cap and the provider cap bound them. |
| Does each transfer keep its own price and rate? | Yes; principal, fees, rate and wallet destination belong to each booking. |
| Can a refund on one transfer be paid out of, or credited to, another transfer? | No; a retry, redirect or refund on one transfer never touches another. |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a customer holds three Mobile Wallet transfers, one credited, one awaiting funds and one whose credit failed. A redirect instruction on the failed one changes only that transfer's wallet destination; the other two keep their own wallets, fees and rates.
